newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Pacific BBA wins A$200 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Pacific BBA wins A$200 mln contract.

text.p: Pacific BBA Ltd said on Tuesday its automotive components unit PBR Automotive Ltd had won a A$200 million, five year contract to provide its Banksia park brake products to a North American vehicle manufacturer.
The company did not identify the manufacturer.

"PBR Automotive has reached agreement with a major North American vehicle manufacturer to supply the Banksia for a range of commercial vehicles," Pacific BBA managing director Barry Jackson said in a statement.
"The programme commences in 1998 and reaches full production in 2000 and, at full volume, is expected to generate revenue of over A$45 million per annum," Jackson said.
The Banksia parking brake products would be made at the company's Melbourne operations, with the contract requiring the training of an additional 70 staff required for the contract.
